![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14203291/assets/b5a42039e2501a3909062fd6ed92e0879df03f58fa85a62b5e738e8abc78b903.png)

Calculate ${∮}_{∂D}8x\,dy-5y\,dx,$ where $D$ is the region shown above.
question.worked_solution:
Let $C$ be a positively oriented, piecewise-smooth, simple closed curve in the plane, and let $D$ be the region bounded by $C.$ If $P$ and $Q$ have continuous first partial derivatives on an open region containing $D,$ then Green's theorem states that

$$
{∮}_{C}P\,dx+Q\,dy={∬}_{D}(\frac{∂Q}{∂x}-\frac{∂P}{∂y})\,\text{d}A.
$$

Green's theorem can be extended to include regions containing holes. In such cases, we can apply Green's theorem in the same way as before.

We have that $P(x,y)=-5y$ and $Q(x,y)=8x.$ So, 

$$
\frac{∂P}{∂y}=-5,\,\frac{∂Q}{∂x}=8.
$$

Therefore, applying Green's theorem, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{∮}_{∂D}8x\,dy-5y\,dx & ={∬}_{D}(\frac{∂Q}{∂x}-\frac{∂P}{∂y})\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}(8-(-5))\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}13\,\text{d}A \\  & =13{∬}_{D}\,\text{d}A \\  & =13\cdot \text{Area}(D) \\  & =13\cdot ({8}^{2}-{6}^{2}) \\  & =13\cdot (64-36) \\  & =13\cdot 28 \\  & =364.\end{aligned}
$$
